blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Retired Chief Justice Artemio Panganiban injected some humor into Wednesday’s proceedings of the Senate Impeachment Court when he jokingly told Senator-judge Risa Hontiveros that he is still single. Panganiban was among the amici curiae, or friends of the court, invited to provide legal opinions on the voting threshold needed to convict in an impeachment trial. READ: Panganiban: Not up to SC to decide on impeachment voting threshold Hours after reading his position and answering questions from senator-judges, the retired justice asked the court if he could be excused by 3 p.m. “The truth is, I’m still jet-lagged.
